statusMetrics.metric: maintained chart rows with model support
statusMetrics.note: The broader outcome-coverage table includes top-100 rows plus retained candidate/version rows; this count is not the top-100 corpus size.
These are the current public catalog entries; production support still depends on lane status.
These charts have proof artifacts but are not promoted catalog entries.
Maintained chart rows with more than one declared base variant, including retained candidate/version rows outside the top-100 corpus.
Rows where a user can start from a public catalog entry, then choose a base and verify the lane they need.

statusMetrics.metric: proof-ready but not public catalog answers
statusMetrics.note: Rows with proof value and useful variants that still need catalog promotion review.
Rows where the current proof is too default-shaped to be a good user offer.
Rows where a named capability gap must be supported, disclosed, deferred, or blocked before promotion.
Rows satisfying all top100 coverage contract items, including disposition and live witness route.
Rows with at least one coverage contract item still todo.
Average of the generated per-chart coverage percentage.
Partial top100 rows ready for catalog promotion review under the strict coverage contract.
Promotion-review rows with two-cluster kind parity selected for the first strict top100 promotion wave.
Low-residue promotion-review rows with clean scan/gate state and no hook/CRD/webhook lifecycle class.
Review-input packets for low-residue candidates. These are not support decisions.
Rendered storage-shape and rollback-boundary review inputs for low-residue candidates. These are not backup, restore, or support decisions.
Partial top100 rows whose proof exists but whose current base is not yet a useful catalog offer.
Proposed base shapes for default-shaped proof-grade charts. These are not supported bases until rendered and proved.
Useful-base proposals that now have recipe variants and cub installer package bases. These still need ConfigHub proof, live evidence, and production disposition.
Grouped proposal families used to assign related base-design work.
Rows where the proposed base shape still needs recipe/package artifacts and proof before catalog promotion.
Partial top100 rows needing a support, disclosure, defer, or block decision before promotion.
Supported top-20 chart versions that still match the latest upstream Helm version in the retained refresh snapshot.
Supported top-20 charts with newer upstream Helm versions that must not be promoted until the full lane reruns.

statusMetrics.metric: update candidates with proof-complete root paths
statusMetrics.note: Latest-version candidates that have root recipe/package paths and proof-complete evidence, but are not replacement catalog rows.
Upstream movement rows whose next action is replacement decision, candidate refresh, or new candidate creation before support changes.
Retained source-scan rows with source feature data.
Retained source-scan rows matched to current recipe/package proof.
Rows promoted to the current public catalog; production gates still matter.
Rows with deterministic proof that are not public catalog entries.

statusMetrics.metric: rows with no current recipe proof
statusMetrics.note: Source reconnaissance rows with no current recipe/package proof yet.
Current recipe exists but the retained source-scan version differs.
Every chart/base row has render parity under recorded inputs.
Rows with upload, scan, or safe-operation proof receipts.
Rows with committed local Kubernetes observation receipts.
Rows where CRD, webhook, controller-owned field, or post-apply API readiness was proven through an explicit lifecycle receipt rather than a plain bulk apply.
Every local live non-pass receipt is mapped to a route class, next action, and proof boundary.
5 rows have non-pass GitOps/OCI receipts.
2 rows have non-pass live parity receipts.
Regular Helm in one vanilla kind cluster, cub installer output in another, then semantic comparison.
Rows where the strict two-cluster receipt records the same Kubernetes object meaning, even when a hook or lifecycle command result still needs review.
Rows with render parity, ConfigHub proof, local live, GitOps live, and live parity all passing.
Base variants that are the cleanest first catalog paths today.

statusMetrics.metric: top20 bases needing unresolved prerequisite or runtime review
statusMetrics.note: Base variants whose render parity is useful but whose target fit, runtime, or lifecycle behavior still needs review.
Golden work orders that specify source base, downstream variant, current cub variant create command, and receipt targets.
Receipts from current cub variant create executions without hidden Helm rerender.
Derived variants that went further through target binding, ConfigHub OCI, Argo sync, and runtime observation.
Catalog-supported recipe artifacts converted into desired-state graph fragments.
Recovered base, override, target-fact, generated-fact, and field-reachability rows.
Edges from a variant to required target facts such as pre-existing Secrets, CRDs, or hook-produced material.
Edges from generated facts to the rendered fields they affect where field reachability is available.
Rows that connect an input, generated fact, or variant change to rendered output fields.
Selected Argo/Flux OCI wave rows; this is not the whole corpus.
Selected top-20 live comparison receipts. Good means every selected receipt currently passes; this is not a claim for every base row.
Committed two-cluster parity receipts for the top-20 base variants, including pass and non-pass results.

statusMetrics.metric: live parity rerun rows needing decisions
statusMetrics.note: Non-pass live parity rows grouped by next action, such as runtime review, staged prerequisites, lifecycle route, or operating policy.

statusMetrics.metric: live parity rows needing model or staging first
statusMetrics.note: Rows where another rerun is not the next useful action until a prerequisite, lifecycle route, or operating policy is handled.

statusMetrics.metric: live parity rows needing target review first
statusMetrics.note: Rows where object parity passed but runtime, storage, controller health, or wait conditions should be reviewed before rerun.
Rows whose committed receipt currently points at a semantic object comparison defect.
Rows whose committed two-cluster receipt currently points at a semantic object comparison defect.
Top-20 catalog charts with required pre-review dispositions closed.
Top-20 catalog charts that still have open disposition work before support review.
Charts with at least one disposition receipt accepted.
Supported, superseded, rejected, or draft target-scoped support decision records.
Support decisions with fresh target evidence and no remaining final requirements.
Proof records kept for deprecated source charts that should not be production-promoted.
Default bases that remain parity evidence but need a better production base or target scope.
Draft support boundaries that still need a final target-scoped decision.
External scan rows that need a fix, hardened base, or explicit production disposition.
Rows still routed to image-pin fixes after the supported-base pinning work.
Rows where host, node, or privileged access is likely part of the chart and needs explicit acceptance or a narrower base.
Quirk axes visible in generated chart or user data.
Visible quirk axes that still need lifecycle or proof coverage.
Detected in source scan but not promoted to front-door chart facts.
Known blind spots in the scanner/data model.

statusMetrics.metric: P0 source quirk work queue rows
statusMetrics.note: Chart-level work items that convert source-scan quirk findings into modeled, reviewable, or provable catalog facts.
Joined shortlist of the P0 source-quirk rows most likely to damage trust if overclaimed.

statusMetrics.metric: top100 dependency-risk rows with maintained locks
statusMetrics.note: Top-100 source rows with remote, vendored, or non-exact dependency risk joined to maintained recipe dependency locks.

statusMetrics.metric: active P0 dependency closure work rows
statusMetrics.note: Highest-priority dependency closure rows needing import, lock, digest, or refresh-survival work. Keep-current rows are excluded.
Top-20 catalog charts that expose raw manifests, tpl snippets, config blocks, sidecars, or add-on slots.
Top-100 chart facts where NGINX-like extension slots are surfaced.
Broader source-scan signal for template-powered inputs; not every tpl use is an explicit supported slot.
Public top-100 source scan rows where the retained source scan found Helm hooks.

statusMetrics.metric: top100 source hook rows still uncovered
statusMetrics.note: Source top-100 hook rows with no maintained lifecycle row and no candidate route plan.
Hook-bearing maintained recipe/package rows with required lifecycle receipt paths; this is not the full top-100 hook inventory.

statusMetrics.metric: source-reviewed hook rows not yet maintained
statusMetrics.note: Source-scan hook or hook-like rows with a reviewed route candidate but no maintained lifecycle receipt yet.

statusMetrics.metric: source hook rows with candidate route plans
statusMetrics.note: Source top-100 hook rows covered by candidate route plans. These are not maintained receipts or runtime observations.

statusMetrics.metric: hook-like candidate rows outside source inventory
statusMetrics.note: Candidate rows that are useful lifecycle work but are not counted as source top-100 hook coverage.
Assignable work orders for turning candidate routes into maintained route receipts, runtime observations, or explicit blockers.
Maintained hook queue rows with a recorded lifecycle route, observation, or blocker.
Maintained hook queue rows with runtime lifecycle observation or execution receipts.
Maintained hook queue rows whose fresh-install route has live observation while another hook phase remains pending.
Separates hook queue rows from hook-like controller lifecycle observations.

statusMetrics.metric: hook queue rows still needing route receipts
statusMetrics.note: Hook-bearing rows whose behavior is inventoried but has no selected route.

statusMetrics.metric: hook routes still needing execution or observation
statusMetrics.note: Hook-bearing rows with a selected route and at least one missing runtime observation or execution receipt.
Cert-manager and External Secrets receipts for CRD/webhook/controller behavior that rendered YAML alone cannot prove.
Public top-100 source scan rows where the retained scan found APIService objects.
Rows where committed receipts observe the rendered APIService object and backing workload. This is not an aggregated API availability claim.

statusMetrics.metric: APIService rows with aggregation availability receipts
statusMetrics.note: Rows with a dedicated Available=True or aggregated API query receipt.
Rows where APIService is visible in the source scan but no maintained recipe/package row exists yet.
